messages:
Eve Tran: hey team :wave: I just finished setting up my devbox and ran the tests. I'm ready to open my first PR but want to follow team norms. quick Qs: branch name pattern? commit message format? who normally reviews first-timer PRs?
Samir Khan: welcome! :tada: Short checklist for first PRs: keep scope tiny, run lint/tests locally, open as a draft while iterating, and add a short description of why. Branches: feature/<initials>/<short-desc> or fix/<issue#>-<short>.
Jon Patel: reviewers — start with the CODEOWNERS for the touched path. If it's app-level, ping @eng; infra changes, ping @eng-infra. For first-timers we usually want 2 reviewers (one owner + one buddy).
Li Wei: commit messages: we use a lightweight conventional style. Example: 
```
feat(cli): add quickstart flag for local dev

Adds --quickstart to skip long setup when running locally.

Fixes: #1234
```
Also include a one-line summary <=72 chars.
Samir Khan: CI requirements: all checks must pass (unit, lint, typecheck). If a flaky test fails, run `./scripts/run-ci-locally` and push a fix or a skip with a ticket. CI Bot will post results in the PR; wait for green before merging.
Eve Tran: do we squash on merge or keep history?
Jon Patel: we squash merge for feature/fix work to keep main clean. Use the PR description to capture the rationale and link issues. For release branches or long-lived branches we keep merge commits.
Li Wei: small style tips: 1) prefer small pure-refactor PRs if changing formatting 2) annotate behavioral changes in the description 3) add a tiny test for new behavior if feasible.
Samir Khan: how to request reviews — click 'Request review' on GitHub and then ping reviewer(s) in slack, e.g., `@Jon Patel` or the team channel with a short note like "ready for review: short summary + test status". If you need an expedited review, add the `review/fast` label.
Eve Tran: got it. Any tips for branch cleanup?
Jon Patel: delete your branch after merge, and if you need to rebase ask in PR thread first. We avoid force-pushing branches that others review.
CI Bot: [automated] pro tip: run `pre-commit run --all-files` before pushing to catch lint/format issues early.
Eve Tran: thanks folks — I'll open a draft PR in a bit and ping for a first-pass review. Appreciate the help! :smile:
Samir Khan: welcome again — ping me if you want a walkthrough of the repo structure before the review.
Li Wei: I can review your first PR tomorrow morning.
Eve Tran: awesome, thanks everyone!
